query: What deterministic rules, fidelity thresholds (e.g., why 80%), and IV/weak‑instrument diagnostics should define per‑protocol and CACE analyses in cluster safety trials?

response.query: What deterministic rules, fidelity thresholds (e.g., why 80%), and IV/weak‑instrument diagnostics should define per‑protocol and CACE analyses in cluster safety trials?
response.answer: Per-protocol and CACE analyses in cluster safety trials require deterministic rules, fidelity thresholds of 80% or higher, and IV diagnostics to ensure instrument strength. Weak instruments should be identified using the F-statistic.

results.title: Quantum Computing, Communication, and Simulation VI
results.content: Migdall, Joint Quantum Institute (United States) High-precision time-correlated single-photon counting (TCSPC), single-photon and entangled-photon generation, quantum communication, and ultrafast quantum optics demand laser sources that deliver both short pulses and exceptional timing stability. We present the performance and application potential of Menhir Photonics' low-noise femtosecond and picosecond laser system, which combines sub-10 fs timing jitter and repetition rates up to 10 GHz. Operating at telecom-compatible wavelengths (1535 or 1553 nm), this type of lasers are already in used as a compelling solution for scalable and field-deployable quantum technologies. Burenkov, National Institute of Standards and Technology (United States), Joint Quantum Institute (United States); Sergey V. Polyakov, National Institute of Standards and Technology (United States), Univ. Path-entangled single-photon states are an attractive resource for entanglement distribution on quantum networks. Quantum information processing and communication protocols based on time-bin entangled photonic qudits Here, we present two frameworks enabling the generation and manipulation of time-bin entangled photonic qudits for both fundamental and applied quantum information processing. National Institute of Standards and Technology (United States), Joint Quantum Institute, University of Maryland (United States)

results.title: News Archive
results.content: A high-performance Intel Core i3-2330M processor with Hyper-Threading technology takes the spotlight in the ZOTAC ZBOX ID82 series to bring mini-PC performance to a whole new level with dual-cores for performance that can dominate much larger-sized tower PCs. Intel HD Graphics 3000 with Intel Quick Sync Video, InTru 3D and Clear Video HD technologies bring lightning-fast GPU-accelerated video conversion, stereoscopic 3D video output and hardware-accelerated Blu-ray 3D playback to the compact ZBOX ID82 series mini-PC. G.SKILL, the worldwide leading high performance memory designer, has showcased the extreme dual channel memory kits, DDR3 2133 MHz 32 GB (4 x 8 GB), compatible with the latest Z77 motherboards at CeBIT 2012. On the MSI Z77A-GD65 and ASRock Z77 Extreme6 motherboards, G.Skill has demonstrated the 32 GB super size memory kits at DDR3 2133 MHz ultra high speed with Intel Core i7 2600K processors. Corsair, a worldwide designer and supplier of high-performance components to the PC gaming hardware market, today announced the availability of the Accelerator Series SSD cache drives.
